topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can't believe this. Grandma's house, the one place I always thought would be a family haven, a place to hold onto our memories, is now just another thing to be divided, dissected, and debated. I’ve been trying to reach out to my sibling, but it feels like we're talking past each other. We grew up together, shared so much of our lives in that house, and now it seems like all that history means nothing. Every conversation ends up the same way—arguments over nothing, accusations flying around, and decisions that seem to benefit only one side. What happened to us just working together, respecting what Grandma wanted for us? It's like we're strangers now, and the only thing that’s clear is that neither of us is willing to budge.
